# Poornima Jagannath

> Poornima Jagannath leads developer experience for Visa Acceptance Platform (VAP). Selected work, essays, and small things built outside work.

## Building

- [Building](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/building): Small things I build outside work. Family projects that have shipped, and an iOS app that is not released yet. These are not professional case studies.
- [Building What's This in Kannada?](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/building/whats-this-in-kannada): A small iOS app for my daughter that teaches Kannada words through images, voice, and play — and what it taught me about language, product, and AI.

## Say hello

- [Say hello](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/connect): How to reach Poornima Jagannath, and where to read the selected work and essays.

## Selected work

- [Selected work](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/work): Public-safe notes on the developer experience work I lead for Visa Acceptance Platform (VAP).
- [A first successful test payment](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/work/visa-acceptance-platform): I lead the path to a first successful test payment on Visa Acceptance Platform (VAP).
- [Docs a person or an agent can follow](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/work/agent-ready-docs): Public tools that check whether docs and generated code can actually be followed.
- [Leading the platform work](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/work/leading-the-platform): I lead the PM team for developer experience on Visa Acceptance Platform (VAP), a high-trust payment platform.

## Writing

- [Writing](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/writing): Essays on developer experience, AI agents, building in the margins, and the small systems that make room for real life.
- [Buying back time with AI agents](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/writing/buying-back-time-with-ai-agents): What a small Slack fleet of AI agents is teaching me about reclaiming time, staying present, and shipping imperfect systems.
- [How this site came together](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/writing/building-this-site-in-the-ai-era): How voice notes, Codex, Markdown, Astro, and Blume turned into a personal site built for people and AI tools to read.
